title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — can we say of sin 'another sinned for us / in our place'?
pass_a_gloss: Placeus presses the asymmetry: 'Christ satisfied for us' does not license 'another sinned for us / in our place.' Sin-talk and satisfaction-talk are not interchangeable slogans.
pass_b_english: We have not satisfied, but another, namely Christ, has satisfied for us. Can the same be said of sin: We have not sinned, but another has sinned for us, or in our place?
source_text: Nos non satisfecimus, sed alius, nempe Christus, pro nobis satisfecit. Idemne dici potest de peccato, Nos non peccavimus, sed alius peccavit pro nobis, aut loco nostro?

lemmas.gloss: Can the same be said of sin?

choices.choice: Christ for us ≠ another sinned for us / in our place
